description.narrative: This allocation of 20 mio. DKK contributes to meeting the objectives of UNICEF’s humanitarian response in Ethiopia. Key planned results for 2022 include: 619,482 children admitted for treatment for severe acute malnutrition, 3 million children vaccinated against measles, 3.5 million people accessing a sufficient quantity of safe water, and 187,000 children/caregivers accessing mental health and psychosocial support.

UNICEF estimates that 12.4 million children in Ethiopia need humanitarian assistance. UNICEF's efforts in Ethiopia focus in particular on health, prevention and treatment of malnutrition, education, access to clean water and sanitation. The un-earmarked funding of 20 mio. DKK contributes towards UNICEF’s efforts to provide these core services, and aims to reach 3.4 million people and over 1.4 million children with humanitarian assistance in 2022.
